decisions.reason: As a newly launched digital module very close to the firm's core practice software and strategic push toward connected workflows, it is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
The education institute is somewhat less core than software but fits the firm's training capabilities and customer retention strategy, so it is more likely to be continued than dropped.
A remote screen sharing support tool directly strengthens the firm's support offering for dental practices and is therefore likely to remain on the market despite being a smaller add-on.
